name: Roadside Fence
summary: A smiling dealer in stolen goods who talks a mark into a very bad bargain.
description: Every bandit camp has a fence, and every fence has a cart, a sign, and a story about where the goods came from. Their real skill is knowing who will pay and who will talk.

actions.name: Honeyed Offer

save.targets: one creature within 30 feet of the fence that can hear and understand it

actions.onFailure: The target has the {ref:condition/charmed} condition until the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Look the Other Way
reactions.text: *Trigger:* A creature the fence can see within 30 feet is hit by an attack roll. *Response:* The fence offers a bribe to the attacker or a witness, and the attacker must succeed on a {dc:cha} Wisdom saving throw or have {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
